protocol: Treadmill maximal exercise test (VO2max, ET) after 500 mL water (placebo arm of a crossover with oligonol); HR before, after and 1-5 min of rest, HRmax, BP and glucose
population: 10 healthy males in their twenties, VO2max about 47 mL/kg/min
note: Spread is mean +/- standard error (stated in Statistical Analysis); placebo column; n = 10; glucose is a single sample.
